gloss_hint: This means living without any system: the desk buried, keys and papers lost, appointments missed and bills paid late, and every plan coming apart for want of order.
This means thinking and talking in a scattered, non-linear way, jumping between topics, losing track of earlier points, and rambling on without clear structure or coherent flow.
This means keeping one's life on a system: everything in its place, lists, labels and a calendar kept, nothing lost or forgotten, and each job set up before it starts.
This means thinking out what one will say before saying it, everything in its place, taking one point at a time in order, and never losing the thread or rambling.
